item.title: Lindsay Clancy juror reflects on mistrial: 'There was so much doubt'
item.description: A juror from Lindsay Clancy's trial discussed deliberations, noting that doubt prevented a guilty verdict.

item.title: Oil reaches $100 per barrel amid fresh U.S.-Iran attacks
item.description: Crude prices hit a seven-week high after U.S. strikes on Iranian tankers prompted Tehran's retaliation.

item.title: Oil prices surpass $100 per barrel as U.S. conflict with Iran persists
item.description: Brent crude, a global benchmark, saw price increases on Wednesday.

item.title: Shelton defeats Alcaraz in late-night marathon, advances to face Tiafoe at US Open
item.description: Ben Shelton ended Carlos Alcaraz's title defense in the latest-finishing match in U.S. Open history, winning 6-7, 6-1, 6-3, 1-6, 7-6.
